title: Chicken Curry Delight
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired curry dish made with tender chicken and a blend of spices. This recipe serves 4 and is ready in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until it starts to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the curry powder, brown sugar, and salt. Cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the curry leaves and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot garnished with fresh cilantro, if desired.
